name: Long Rest
desc: A long rest is a period of extended downtime, at least 8 hours long, during which a character sleeps or performs light activity for no more than 2 hours. At the end of a long rest, a character regains all lost hit points and recovers spent Hit Dice up to a number equal to half the character's total (minimum one). A character must have at least 1 hit point at the start of the rest to gain its benefits, and can't benefit from more than one long rest in a 24-hour period.
